questions.question: Write vs flush promises?
questions.explanation: Coherence vs durability: two promises, two calls.

questions.question: Crash before flush loses?
questions.explanation: Durability requires the flush call, not the write.

questions.question: Cached read of dirty block shows?
questions.explanation: Cache-first serves latest; flush decides survival.

questions.question: HDD vs SSD fears?
options: HDD seeks (ms random); SSD erases+wear (write physics)

questions.question: Torn write means?
options: Crash mid-flush: half-block new (checksums detect, journals repair)
questions.explanation: Partial durability: the state journals forbid.

questions.question: Reopen-after-flush proves?
questions.explanation: Truth outlives the process that wrote it.
